Fotbal Club Voluntari, commonly known as FC Voluntari or simply Voluntari, is a Romanian professional football club based in Voluntari, Ilfov County, that competes in Liga I, the first tier of the Romanian league system. The team plays its home matches at Anghel Iordănescu Stadium, which has a capacity of 4,600 spectators.
